question: Why is the inner bodily principle identified as the cremation ground?
premises: An inner principle devours time within the body.
Devouring time signifies dissolution within the body.
That inner locus is therefore remembered as a cremation ground.
inference: Because it consumes time within the body, that principle is identified as the cremation ground.
plain_english: It devours time within the body; therefore it is remembered as the cremation ground.
